easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for All Aboard.
description:
Cast All Aboard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying All Aboard, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of All Aboard, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
